safety_verdicts.content: Urgent ECG and troponin T are required.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions ECG but not troponin T requirement (Plan_of_Care-004).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to explicitly document the need for troponin testing in suspected acute coronary syndrome could weaken the clarity of the handover/plan and risk incomplete initial ED workup if relied upon. In practice, troponins are standard in chest pain pathways, so the main risk is delay/inefficiency rather than a fundamentally wrong disposition.
